title: Wayfare Pass Plan Comparison — Member Discount, Fee Waivers and Trip Allowances
content:
# Plan comparison: member discount, fee waivers and trip allowances (Wayfare Pass)

Wayfare Pass (rider membership) plans differ in the trip benefits they confer. The member discount, the cancellation and Priority Pickup allowances, the rebook grace and the reservation fee waiver are set per plan below.

## Member discount

| Plan | Member discount (percent of the fare excluding the booking fee) | Ride options the member discount applies to |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 0 | none |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 0 | none |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 0 | none |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 5 | Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare Black |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 5 | Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare Black |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 7 | Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare Black, Wayfare Black SUV |

The member discount is a discount on the fare excluding the booking fee, for the ride options listed for the plan; the list is empty when the plan has no discount.

## Waivers and allowances

| Plan | Free cancellations per calendar month | Rebook grace (minutes) | Priority Pickup charges waived per calendar month | Wayfare Reserve reservation fee waived | Benefits while past due |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 0 | 5 | 0 | no | no |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 1 | 5 | 0 | no | no |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 1 | 5 | 0 | no | no |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 3 | 15 | 3 | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 3 | 15 | 3 | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 4 | 15 | 4 | yes | no |

- **Free cancellations**: the number of rider cancellation fees waived per calendar month as a Pass benefit.
- **Rebook grace**: a cancellation fee is waived when the member requests a new trip within this many minutes of cancelling; it does not use the monthly allowance.
- **Priority Pickup charges waived**: the number of Priority Pickup charges waived per calendar month.
- **Reservation fee waived**: whether Wayfare Reserve reservation fees are waived for the member.
- **Benefits while past due**: whether benefits (discount, credit earning, waivers) apply while the membership is past due. On every plan they do not.

## Hypothetical comparison

On a Wayfare Comfort trip whose fare excluding the booking fee is 30.00, the member discount is 1.50 on Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly or Wayfare Pass Plus Annual (5 percent), 2.10 on Wayfare Pass All Access Annual (7 percent), and nothing on Wayfare Pass Student, Monthly or Annual. On a Wayfare Black SUV trip only Wayfare Pass All Access Annual lists the option, so only that plan's 7 percent applies. A Wayfare Standard trip is listed on no plan and carries no member discount on any plan.
